provenance.aux_max_load_t: PENDING modelling decision (wj). null keeps the 150 t cranes out of service; set a number to enable them for the task types above whose recorded load is at or below it.
provenance.aux_allowed_task_types: Stage-1 placeholder derived from the ETL stage names; wj should confirm which stage types a 150 t crane may ever serve.

notes: The 150 t cranes are physically able to lift an empty hook (no load) and, depending on the pending threshold, some empty-ladle legs whose recorded load is around 130-146 t.
Enabling the aux cranes must not bypass the stage-1 safety gate: every produced plan is still checked by rail_model.verify_schedule.
